pool.text: Charles Throsby Smith led the first British expedition into the area.
Joshua John Moore named his land grant Canberry after local people.
The Anglican church of St John the Baptist was consecrated in Reid.
The federation of the colonies of Australia was officially achieved.
The federal parliament passed the Seat of Government Act confirming Dalgety.
The NSW government ceded the district to the federal government.
The daily newspaper The Canberra Times was established.
The Yarralumla property was officially dubbed Government House.
The Albert Hall opened as the city's first performing arts venue.
The ACT gained its first federal parliamentary representation in the House.
Lake Burley Griffin was completed after four years of work.
A larger and permanent Parliament House opened on Capital Hill.
The Royal Canberra Hospital was closed before its controversial demolition.
Canberra became the first city to set a vision of no waste.
The ACT Government signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Hangzhou Municipal Peoples Government.
Traffic cameras were first introduced to Canberra by the government.
Bushfires engulfed parts of Canberra and destroyed Mount Stromlo Observatory.
The Canberra Dili Friendship Agreement was signed to build friendship and mutual respect.
Prisoners began being held at the Alexander Maconochie Centre.
Plastic bags under a certain thickness were banned from retail distribution.
